analysis.title: USA: GS Economic Indicators Update
key_insights: The nominal GS US Financial Conditions Index tightened by 31.9bp to 99.22 since November 9, mostly due to lower equity prices and a higher 10-year Treasury yield.
The real GS US FCI tightened by 31.7bp to 98.98 over the same period.
GS Q4 GDP tracking forecast is +2.4% quarter-over-quarter annualized.
The GS US MAP index of economic surprises declined on net to +0.53.
The GS October Current Activity Indicator is +3.1%, unchanged from September.

The update also covers the Capex Tracker, Slack Tracker, Job Growth Tracker, manufacturing and non-manufacturing survey trackers, Wage Tracker, Core Inflation Tracker and the Social Media Economic Sentiment Index. The text gives no readings for these.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Tighter financial conditions, driven mainly by lower equity prices and a higher 10-year Treasury yield, act as a drag on growth.
The inflation-adjusted index tightened by almost the same amount as the nominal index.
GS's own tracking estimate for advance Q4 GDP growth.
Data surprises are still net positive versus expectations, but the index declined on net.
Underlying activity growth is unchanged from September.

charts_described: The change in the GS nominal FCI since November 9, 2026 is split by component. The tightening is 31.9bp for the total FCI, 0.0bp for Fed Funds, 9.9bp for the 10-year Treasury yield, 1.2bp for BBB credit spread, 15.4bp for log SPX and 5.3bp for log TWI, if the chart labels are read in the order of the axis categories. The text does not tie each figure to a component, so this mapping is uncertain.
